identity_block: The hand is Grace's real hand from the reference photos: warm brown skin, square medium-length nails painted pink with crisp white French tips, a small gold ring with a clear heart-shaped stone on one finger. One hand enters from the frame edge with the whole wrist visible, natural relaxed fingers, five fingers, realistic knuckles and skin texture.
ring_block: The blue ring is the ThunderFit silicone band from the ring reference photo: a smooth domed classic-width band about 5 mm wide, pearlescent medium blue with a soft satin sheen, solid colour, no stone, no logo, no pattern. Keep its exact shape, width and blue.
crown_block: On the ring finger she wears her silver crown-style engagement ring set with a round clear stone, as in the reference.
scene_block: Bright natural daylight, clean neutral colours, sharp focus on the hand, shallow depth of field, real phone camera look, no text, no logos, no watermark.
video_suffix: Handheld phone camera, smooth natural motion, real speed, the hand and ring keep their exact shape and colour in every frame, no flicker, no morphing, no extra fingers, no text.

shots.still: Close-up at a bright gym: her hand rests on a black padded weight bench next to a clear water bottle, fingers spread, beginning to pinch the silver engagement ring on her ring finger.
shots.video: She slides the silver engagement ring off her ring finger and sets it down next to the water bottle, then her hand pulls away. The handheld camera pushes in slowly toward the ring on the bench.

shots.still: Close-up inside a car in daylight: her fingertips dig into the centre console cup holder full of loose coins, a black hair tie and a receipt. Her ring finger is bare.
shots.video: Her fingers dig quickly through the coins and the hair tie in the cup holder, searching, lifting a coin and dropping it. The camera tilts down quickly and follows her hand.

shots.still: Next to a bright window with sheer white curtains: her fingertips hold the blue ring up at eye level between thumb and index finger, light catching its pearly sheen. Her ring finger is bare.
shots.video: She lifts the blue ring into frame and slowly turns it between her fingertips so the sheen rolls across the band. The camera orbits slightly around her hand.

shots.still: Close-up by the same bright window: the blue ring sits at the tip of her bare ring finger, her other hand's thumb and index finger about to push it on.
shots.video: She slides the blue ring all the way down onto her ring finger, then spreads her fingers and gently squeezes the soft band with her thumb, it flexes slightly. The camera pulls back a little as her fingers spread.

shots.still: Bright gym: her hand wearing the blue ring on the ring finger wraps around the black handle of a small hex dumbbell resting on the rubber floor.
shots.video: Her hand grips the dumbbell handle firmly and lifts it up off the floor. The camera tracks upward with the dumbbell.

shots.still: Bright white kitchen sink: her hand wearing the blue ring on the ring finger holds a white plate under the running tap, water splashing.
shots.video: She rinses the plate under the running water, turning it, water flowing over her fingers and the blue ring. The camera dollies slowly sideways.

shots.still: On a light wooden dresser in morning light: the blue ring lies in a small round white ceramic trinket dish, a small plant blurred behind.
shots.video: The blue ring rolls a little in the dish and settles to a stop. The camera pushes in slowly toward it.

shots.still: On a white table: a small open white gift box holds TWO identical blue rings side by side on white padding, a loose white satin ribbon beside it; her hand wearing a blue ring on the ring finger rests at the box lid.
shots.video: Her hand slides the white drawer box fully open, then pulls the white ribbon across the table. The camera pushes in toward the two blue rings in the box.
